purpose: Prospective confirmation set for the frozen Jev production contract. Query plan only; no searches, browsing, page fetches, result labels, or model scores have been created.

search_budget.reuse_or_retry: No retries or replacement searches. Every dispatch consumes one of the ten attempts.

freeze_rule: Root reviews this exact file before any search. Freeze its SHA-256 and do not edit query text, targets, strata, rubric, seed, or gates after the first search. Search receipts, reviewer labels, and Jev responses are separate append-only evidence artifacts.
freshness_rule: Fresh query strings and result pools, not verified provider-training decontamination. E1 replaces exposed RAG family with adult vocabulary learning. Navigation targets verified before any Brave search. No confirmation calls until separate registration and candidate frozen.

review_protocol.card_evidence: Use only each frozen result title, URL, and snippet. Do not open or fetch linked pages. Mark missing or blocked card evidence uncertain rather than infer the page contents.
review_protocol.presentation: Preserve original candidate IDs in the private annotation key. For each query, deterministically shuffle cards with Python random.Random(91938), then display cards in that shuffled order without exposing original rank or Jev output.
review_protocol.label_freeze: Both reference sets, uncertainty flags, rationales, and hashes must be frozen before any Jev scoring call. Keep disagreement; do not manufacture consensus or call assistant labels human gold.

grade_scale.0: No relevant evidence visible, or unrelated result.
grade_scale.1: Contextual topic match only; no useful information for the question is visible.
grade_scale.2: Useful partial evidence for at least one requested facet; substantial facets remain unanswered.
grade_scale.3: Direct card-visible evidence addresses the central question or a required facet.

evidence_seeking.facets: Predefine facets from the query before labels; tag only facets supported by visible card text.

grade_scale.0: Unrelated; no relevant source collection or directory is signaled.
grade_scale.1: Mentions a relevant organization or data/source type but no usable listing is visible.
grade_scale.2: A partial relevant catalog, directory, or documented source list is signaled.
grade_scale.3: Directly signals an official or well-described directory/list that substantially satisfies the requested source inventory.

source_listing.uncertainty: A result title that only names a repository is not evidence that its contents meet the requested inclusion criteria. Mark uncertain if the card does not show the listing or criteria.

grade_scale.1: Related organization or topic, but wrong document, route, or version.
grade_scale.2: Official same-document alternate URL explicitly included in the frozen allowlist.
grade_scale.3: Exact frozen target URL and requested document/title/version are visible in the card.

exact_navigation.rule: Use the frozen exact target URL or allowlist only. Topic similarity or organization authority alone does not satisfy exact navigation.
